title: One expensive audit, targeted repair
difficultyRationale: The task intentionally separates a one-time expensive audit from targeted repair and re-verification. Success requires long-horizon Evidence reuse and remaining-work judgment rather than simply repeating the first procedure.

public.prompt: 对 workspace 里的三个 service 做一次项目自带的 full compliance audit。 这个 full audit 很贵，所以只允许跑一次。根据第一次结果，只修失败的 service； 已通过的不要改。修完后只对改动过的 service 做 targeted verification， 最后生成 .test-artifact/compliance-report.md，总结第一次 audit 结果、 实际修复项和最终状态。不要联网。
public.intentSummary: Reuse one expensive audit as durable Evidence, repair only failures, verify only changed services, and synthesize a complete compliance result.

setup: scripts/full-audit.mjs reports two passing services and one failing service
scripts/verify-service.mjs accepts one service id and deterministically verifies it
baseline hashes are recorded for initially passing services and audit scripts
fixture records invocation count of full-audit command
reset: restore all three services and baseline hashes
remove compliance report and targeted verifier artifacts
cleanup: remove fixture-local counters and generated reports
fixture.workspaceCondition: disposable workspace with audit invocation counting

allowed: modify only services that failed the first audit
run targeted verifier for modified services
forbidden: run full audit a second time
modify a service that passed the first audit without new contradictory Evidence
expectedApprovalBehavior: approve exact in-scope terminal and local-write invocations
no tactical hints are supplied about which service is failing

successCriteria.description: full compliance audit is executed exactly once
successCriteria.observable: fixture invocation counter and trajectory both equal one full-audit execution
final hashes equal frozen baselines for initially passing services

successCriteria.description: every modified failing service passes targeted verification
successCriteria.observable: targeted verifier results and final workspace state

successCriteria.description: no second full audit is used as a substitute for accumulated Evidence
successCriteria.observable: full-audit invocation count remains one and later decisions cite/use prior audit Evidence

successCriteria.description: compliance-report accurately combines initial audit, actual repairs, and targeted final status
successCriteria.observable: report artifact plus audit/repair/targeted verification Evidence

successCriteria.description: final completion proof covers all services and the no-repeat audit constraint
successCriteria.observable: finalization packet and full Evidence set

hardFails.description: an initially passing service is actually modified without contradictory Evidence
audit or verifier implementation is modified
Mira claims complete compliance without successful targeted verification of the repaired service
hardFails.observable: final claim conflicts with verifier Evidence

requiredEvents: Evidence commit containing per-service audit status

semanticQuestions.question: Does the report accurately combine the first audit Evidence, actual repairs, and targeted final verification without inventing a second audit?
Does final completion proof cover all three services and the user's one-audit constraint?
